tier1.headline: Your Data Improves AI
tier1.quote: If you use the FAQs and submit a question that is not covered in the pool of available answers, you will be prompted to enter your email address.

tier1.headline: Your Browsing Collected Without Consent
tier1.quote: When you visit our websites, the web server temporarily records the domain name or IP address of your computer, the file request (file name and URL) from the client, the http response code, and the website from which you are visiting us.

tier1.headline: Your Data Shared With Partners
tier1.quote: We and our partners use these processings to show you personalized content that is relevant to you.

tier1.headline: Your Data Goes Overseas
tier1.quote: In some cases, your data is also processed in countries outside the European Union (i.e. in so-called third countries), currently for example: Storage/hosting of customer data (excluding traffic data) by Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Microsoft Ireland Operations Ltd., Google Cloud EMEA Limited, Ireland and Salesforce.com Germany GmbH in Europe.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: Deutsche Telekom AG’s General Data Privacy Information applies to the processing of your personal data.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Profiled Automatically
tier2.quote: Within the framework of the legal regulations, user profiles are created.

tier2.headline: Your Ads Are Personalized
tier2.quote: We use these processing’s to show you personalized ads and content that is relevant to you.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Legally
tier2.quote: Due to legal obligation : In certain cases, we are required by law to transmit certain data to the requesting government entity.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Rights Limited
tier2.quote: If you unsubscribe, your registration data will be stored for up to three and a half years, purely for purposes of demonstrating your consent.

tier2.headline: Your Data Stored Long-Term
tier2.quote: The logged data is used exclusively for data security purposes, in particular to defend against attacks on our server.
